ei.title: The Power of Kindness Over Hostility
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Once upon a time, there was a king who lived in a beautiful palace. While the king was away, a monster approached the gates of the palace. The monster was so ugly and smelly that the guards froze in shock. He passed the guards and sat on the king's throne. The guards soon came to their senses, went in, and shouted at the monster, demanding that he get off the throne. With each bad word the guards used, the monster grew more ugly and smelly. The guards got even angrier — they began to brandish their swords to scare the monster away from the palace. But he just grew bigger and bigger, eventually taking up the whole room. He grew more ugly and smelly than ever. Eventually the king returned. He was wise and kind and saw what was happening. He knew what to do. He smiled and said to the monster, "Welcome to my palace!" He asked the monster if he wanted a cup of coffee. The monster began to grow smaller as he drank the coffee. The king offered him some take-out pizza and fries. The guards immediately called for pizza. The monster continued to get smaller with the king's kind gestures. He then offered the monster a full body massage. As the guards helped with the relaxing massage, the monster became tiny. With another act of kindness to the monster, he just disappeared.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ freezing → froze: so ... that절의 정동사 자리이므로 과거형 필요
det.analysis:
❌ ① who: a king who lived(주격 관계대명사), 정상

❌ ② approached: a monster approached(다가갔다), 과거형 정상

✅ ③ freezing → froze: 'the guards ___ in shock' — so ... that절의 정동사 자리이므로 과거형 froze가 맞음. freezing(분사)은 정동사 불가 ← 정답

❌ ④ to scare: to scare the monster away(쫓아내려고), 목적의 to부정사 정상
det.tip: 주어 + 정동사(froze). 분사 freezing은 정동사 불가

det.korean: ② demanded → demanding: 접속사 없이 이어지므로 분사구문이 필요
det.analysis:
❌ ① passed: passed the guards(지나쳤다), 과거형 정상

✅ ② demanded → demanding: 'shouted at the monster, ___ that he get off' — 이미 정동사 shouted가 있고 접속사가 없으므로 분사구문 demanding(요구하면서)이 맞음. demanded(정동사)는 두 동사가 접속사 없이 이어져 오류 ← 정답

❌ ③ get off: demand that + (should) 동사원형, 정상

❌ ④ grew: grew more ugly(점점 ~해졌다), 과거형 정상
det.tip: shouted ..., demanding ~ : 분사구문(동시 동작)

questions.passage: Once upon a time, there was a king who lived in a beautiful palace. While the king was away, a monster approached the gates of the palace. The monster was so ugly and smelly that the guards froze in shock. He passed the guards and sat on the king's throne. The guards soon came to their senses, went in, and shouted at the monster, demanding that he get off the throne. With each bad word the guards used, the monster grew more ugly and smelly. The guards got even angrier — they began to brandish their swords to scare the monster away from the palace. But he just grew bigger and bigger, eventually taking up the whole room. He grew more ugly and smelly than ever. Eventually the king returned. He was wise and kind and saw what was happening. He knew what to do. He smiled and said to the monster, "Welcome to my palace!" He asked the monster if he wanted a cup of coffee. The monster began to grow smaller as he drank the coffee. The king offered him some take-out pizza and fries. The guards immediately called for pizza. The monster continued to get smaller with the king's kind gestures. He then offered the monster a full body massage. As the guards helped with the relaxing massage, <u>the monster became tiny</u>. With another act of kindness to the monster, he just disappeared.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>the monster became tiny</u>가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 괴물은 적대감의 상징으로, 친절 앞에서 힘을 잃고 작아졌다는 뜻이다.

밑줄: 'As the guards helped with the relaxing massage, the monster became tiny' — 괴물은 분노·적대감으로 커지고 친절로 작아짐

❌ ① 실제로 작은 동물: 비유를 문자적으로 해석

❌ ② 속여서 쫓아냄: 본문과 무관

✅ ③ 적대감이 힘을 잃고 사그라듦: 친절(커피·피자·마사지) 앞에서 적대감의 상징인 괴물이 작아짐 ← 정답

❌ ④ 잠들게 함: 문자적 해석일 뿐
det.tip: 괴물 = 적대감의 비유. 친절로 작아짐 = 적대감이 사그라듦
